dialogue.fateapocrypha.lab_tank.1: ...Cold. My whole body feels like it belongs to someone else.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.lab_tank.2: I don't remember who I am. Only this light... and the glass around me.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.lab_tank.3: I don't want to die for someone else's wishes. I have to get out. I'll try to break the glass.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.lab_walk.1: My legs won't obey me. I'll have to walk slowly.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.lab_walk.2: There are other tanks around me. All empty... Who are they for?
dialogue.fateapocrypha.lab_walk.3: I hear voices far away. Better stay quiet.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.lab_walk.4: There's light ahead. That must be the exit.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.lab_walk.5: Just a little more... I'm getting dizzy...
dialogue.fateapocrypha.corridor.1: My legs... they give out... I'm falling...
dialogue.fateapocrypha.corridor.3: Whoa, you're from the tank! You can't wander around here alone, they'll find you!
dialogue.fateapocrypha.corridor.5: I'm Astolfo, Rider of Black! Don't worry, I won't hand you over. Let's go to Chiron, he'll help.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.chiron.1: You're awake? Don't get up too quickly, your body is still weak.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.chiron.3: In my chambers. I am Chiron, Archer of Black. Astolfo found you in the corridor.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.chiron.4: He was shaking all over! Chiron, you'll save him, right?
dialogue.fateapocrypha.chiron.5: You are a homunculus, made as a mana source for the Servants. Yet you awakened on your own, which should not happen.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.chiron.6: I will tend to your wounds. Rest while no one knows you're here.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.escape.1: Chiron! Bad news: the Masters noticed the homunculus is gone. The castle is on alert!
dialogue.fateapocrypha.escape.2: Then there's no time. Rider, take him away from here. I will hold off anyone who follows.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.escape.3: Got it! Let's go before it's too late!
dialogue.fateapocrypha.escape.4: Here, take this. You'll feel safer with a weapon. And stay close to me!
dialogue.fateapocrypha.escape.6: Faster! Don't look back, they're already searching for us!
dialogue.fateapocrypha.escape.7: Just a bit more and we're at the gate. The forest is beyond it!
dialogue.fateapocrypha.escape.8: The gate is locked... Give me a second.

story.fateapocrypha.interlude_shiro.obje: Watch and listen: this is the story of other heroes.
story.fateapocrypha.interlude_frankenste: Watch and listen: this is the story of other heroes.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.shiro.1: People are born, suffer and die. How many more generations must go through this?
dialogue.fateapocrypha.shiro.2: You speak of salvation again, Shirou. Whatever you plan, I will follow you.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.shiro.3: The Greater Holy Grail and the Third Magic, the materialization of souls. Human souls will become immortal: without pain, sickness or death.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.shiro.4: A beautiful dream. But then humanity must give up growth, and itself.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.shiro.5: Give up pain, not themselves. I cannot watch them suffer and do nothing.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.shiro.6: And if they don't want such salvation?
dialogue.fateapocrypha.shiro.7: I am Amakusa Shirou Tokisada. Once I already died for people. Now I will save them, even against their will.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.shiro.8: Then my Hanging Gardens shall become your fortress, my Master.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.shiro.9: No one must learn of this too soon. Especially Mordred and Kairi: they do not trust me.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.frank.1: Don't be afraid, Frankenstein. Whatever happens, we'll face it together.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.frank.2: Caules... kind. Frankenstein... will protect Caules.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.frank.3: Found you! Berserker of Black. I won't be bored!
dialogue.fateapocrypha.frank.4: That's Saber of Red! Frankenstein, be careful!
dialogue.fateapocrypha.frank.5: Don't... hurt Caules! Frankenstein... won't allow it!
dialogue.fateapocrypha.frank.6: Try and stop me, iron girl!
dialogue.fateapocrypha.frank.7: Caules... forgive me. Frankenstein... all my power... now!
dialogue.fateapocrypha.frank.11: You were. You were the best, Frankenstein... Forgive me.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.forest.1: The forest! A little more and we'll lose our pursuers.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.forest.3: Wait... Do you hear that? They sent Yggdmillennia's golems after us! Get ready!
dialogue.fateapocrypha.forest.4: I'll cover you! Strike anyone who gets close!
dialogue.fateapocrypha.forest.6: Siegfried?! And Gordes... They caught up with us!
dialogue.fateapocrypha.forest.7: Enough. You are expendable material, and your place was in the tank.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.forest.8: It hurts... I don't want... to die...
dialogue.fateapocrypha.forest.9: Hold on! Don't close your eyes!
dialogue.fateapocrypha.forest.10: ...Master. This being wants to live. I cannot let it die.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.forest.11: What are you doing, Siegfried?! I order you to stop!
dialogue.fateapocrypha.forest.12: Forgive me, Master. I will give him my heart.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.forest.13: Live. Live for both of us... From now on, your name is Sieg.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.forest.14: Sieg... My name. And my heart... it beats.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.forest.15: Impossible... My Servant... A hero gave his heart to a reject?!
dialogue.fateapocrypha.forest.16: Come on, Sieg! Hurry, before he recovers!
dialogue.fateapocrypha.forest.17: I will go back to the castle. I will free the other homunculi.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.forest.18: Then I'm with you. Let's go!
dialogue.fateapocrypha.red.1: So you're my Master. A necromancer from the Mage's Association, huh? Go on, give your orders. That's all anyone ever does.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.red.2: Give orders? Not my style. Want to do something? Do it. I just want us both to live to the end of this war.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.red.3: ...You're strange. I am Mordred. I was made as a clone of King Arthur, but I consider myself his son. I will become king of Britain.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.red.4: A future king. Sounds impressive. I don't care for fancy words, but I respect your wish.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.red.5: Arthur rejected me and refused to acknowledge me. I will prove I am worthy of the throne.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.red.6: You will. I won't get in your way, and I don't need you obedient. I need a partner, not a puppet.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.red.7: Partner... No one ever called me that. They looked at me either as a weapon or as a mistake.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.red.8: I don't care how they looked at you before. I see a Servant with character and strength. That's enough for me.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.red.9: ...Ha. Fine, Kairi. It's a deal. But I warn you: I'll do things my own way.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.red.10: That's exactly what I expect. And stay alert: I don't like that priest Shirou.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.red.11: Neither do I. That priest smiles far too much.
story.fateapocrypha.celenike.title: Celenike
story.fateapocrypha.celenike.objective: Return to the castle: Celenike is looking for Astolfo.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.celenike.1: Rider! So this is where you've been. You're protecting this reject?!
dialogue.fateapocrypha.celenike.2: Celenike, he's alive! He's not an object, and homunculi shouldn't be killed for other people's wishes.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.celenike.3: You are my Servant! You have no right to care for him. I'll remind you who you answer to.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.celenike.4: I'm not an object. I want to live, and I won't abandon the other homunculi.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.celenike.5: By Command Seal I order you: Rider, attack the homunculus!
dialogue.fateapocrypha.celenike.6: No... Celenike... my body... won't obey... Sieg, run!
dialogue.fateapocrypha.celenike.7: By the second seal I order you: strike him! You will obey me!
dialogue.fateapocrypha.celenike.8: I... don't want to... Hold on, Sieg... I won't let myself... touch you...
dialogue.fateapocrypha.celenike.9: With my last seal I command you, Ri...
dialogue.fateapocrypha.celenike.10: I'm tired of listening to that shrieking.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.celenike.11: A Master who breaks her own Servant isn't worth even my sword. I simply found it disgusting.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.celenike.12: Don't think I saved you. I don't care about you.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.celenike.13: ...The commands no longer bind me. She's dead.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.celenike.15: Without a Master I can't last long. If you don't mind... become my Master, Sieg.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.celenike.16: I accept. Together we will free the other homunculi.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.celenike.17: The seal on your hand... Now we're truly bound. Let's go, Sieg!

story.fateapocrypha.golem_adam.subtitle: An Artificial Paradise
story.fateapocrypha.golem_adam.objective: Stop Golem Adam together with Jeanne and Astolfo.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.spartacus.1: Spartacus, you hate tyrants. Before you stands the castle of the Yggdmillennia clan, a stronghold of those who keep people in cages.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.spartacus.2: Oppressors... Oppressors! I will break down their walls!
dialogue.fateapocrypha.spartacus.3: Go. Free the oppressed. Let your fury do the heavy work for me.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.spartacus.4: You... give orders too? I am no slave! I obey... no one!
dialogue.fateapocrypha.spartacus.5: Hey, big guy! He's lost his mind. Next he'll tear everything around apart.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.spartacus.6: Stop smashing everything! Stop before it's too late!
dialogue.fateapocrypha.spartacus.7: Tyrants... tyrants everywhere! I will not stop!
dialogue.fateapocrypha.spartacus.8: Forgive me, strongman. You didn't deserve such an end... but there is no other way to stop you.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.spartacus.9: Such power, used however they pleased. This war is growing more dangerous.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.jeanne.1: The city is so big... So many people, so many lights. I've never seen anything like it.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.jeanne.2: Get used to it, Sieg. This is your world now too.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.jeanne.3: Excuse me... Are you Sieg? The homunculus who received Siegfried's heart?
dialogue.fateapocrypha.jeanne.5: I am Jeanne d'Arc, the Ruler of this war. In this world I wear the form of a girl named Letitia, whose body I use.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.jeanne.6: Before his death, Siegfried asked me to watch over you. I will fulfil his request.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.jeanne.7: Siegfried... He gave me his heart, and now he even asked on my behalf. I don't know how to thank him.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.jeanne.8: Live. That is what he wanted. And I will stay by your side while you are in danger.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.jeanne.9: Wow, the Ruler! Now we have a powerful ally! Right, Sieg?
dialogue.fateapocrypha.jeanne.10: When she smiles, I feel warm. I don't understand what this is.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.jeanne.11: I am the Ruler, Sieg. I cannot choose a side in this war. But no one can forbid me from protecting someone in need.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.jack.1: Quiet... The air has changed. It's a trap: we're being pulled into an illusion!
dialogue.fateapocrypha.jack.2: Fog, gas lamps... This isn't Trifas. We're in a strange, imaginary city.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.jack.3: It's so cold here... and I feel hatred. So much hatred.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.jack.4: You came to our city... We're cold... so cold... Give us your lives...
dialogue.fateapocrypha.jack.5: It isn't a single soul, Sieg. It's hundreds of children's souls fused together. Jack the Ripper is their shared pain and hatred.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.jack.6: They just want someone to hear them...
dialogue.fateapocrypha.jack.7: Mother... why did it hurt... why did no one protect us...
dialogue.fateapocrypha.jack.8: Back! Don't you dare touch these children!
dialogue.fateapocrypha.jack.9: Atalanta, they are no longer children. This is hatred that kills the living. It must be stopped.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.jack.10: They're defenseless! I won't let anyone hurt them again!
dialogue.fateapocrypha.jack.11: Forgive me. It is the only way to give them peace.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.jack.12: No... No! You killed the children! You killed them again!
dialogue.fateapocrypha.jack.13: I will never forgive you, Jeanne d'Arc. Never.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.jack.14: They're gone... smiling. Are you... crying?
dialogue.fateapocrypha.jack.15: I had no other choice. But Atalanta will hate me now.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.avi.1: A world without suffering. A perfect humanity. My Golem Adam is nearly complete.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.avi.2: We strive for the same thing, Avicebron. Stand on my side and your dream will come true.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.avi.3: Avicebron, what does 'stand on his side' mean? We're fighting for the Black faction!
dialogue.fateapocrypha.avi.4: I have betrayed the Blacks, Roche. To complete the Golem, a Master's life is required. Yours.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.avi.5: No... Wait... It isn't true! Avicebron!
dialogue.fateapocrypha.avi.6: Thank you. Your life will not be wasted. Awaken, Adam!
dialogue.fateapocrypha.avi.7: Wonderful. Now the world will see the paradise you have made.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.gol.1: He's turning everything around into an artificial paradise. Earth, grass, people... everything becomes unreal.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.gol.2: This isn't paradise. There is no freedom and no choice in it.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.gol.3: We'll stop this giant together! Right, Sieg?
dialogue.fateapocrypha.gol.4: You don't understand. Golem Adam will give humanity a world without pain. It must be done!
dialogue.fateapocrypha.gol.5: A world created by force cannot be paradise. Forgive me, Avicebron.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.gol.6: My ideal... Adam... why is it collapsing?
dialogue.fateapocrypha.gol.7: An ideal imposed on everyone inevitably leads to destruction.
dialogue.fateapocrypha.gol.10: But the world survived. Let's keep going, Sieg!
